title: Namaz for fulfillment of needs (5)
data:
ANOTHER NAMAZ FOR SETTLING THE NEEDS

This prayer has been reported by a big number of scholars, such as Shaykh al-Mufid, al-Tusi, Sayyid Ibn Tawus, and many others, from Imam al-Sadiq(a.s.). However, according to the report of Sayyid Ibn Tawus, the way of offering this prayer is as follows:

When you have an urgent need and you wish Almighty Allah to grant it for you, you may observe fasting on three successive days; Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday. On Friday, you may bathe yourself, dress yourself with a new, clean costume, go up to the highest point in your house, and offer a two-unit prayer. Then, you may raise your hands towards the sky and say the following supplication:
اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّىْ حَلَلْتُ بِسَاحَتِكَ لِمَعْرِفَتِىْ بِوَحْدَانِيَّتِكَ وَ صَمَدَا نِيَّتِكَ وَ اَنَّهٗ لَا قَادِرًا عَلٰى قَضَاۤءِ حَاجَتِىْ غَيْرُكَ وَ قَدْ عَلِمْتُ يَا رَبِّ اَنَّهٗ كُلَّمَا تَظَاهَرَتْ نِعْمَتُكَ عَلَىَّ اشْتَدَّتْ فَاقَتِىْ اِلَيْكَ وَ قَدْ طَرَقَنِىْ هَمُّ كَذَا وَ كَذَا.
AALLAAHUMA AINIAA HALALTU BISAAHATIKA LIMAA'RIFATIAA BIWAHDAANIYATIKA WA SAMADAA NIYATIKA WA AANAHU LAA QAADIRANA A'ALAAAA QADAA'I HAAJATIAA GHAYRUKA WA QAD A'ALIMTU YAA RABI AANAHU KULAMAA TAZAAHARAT NIA'MATUKA A'ALAAAA ASHTADAT FAAQATIAA AILAYKA WA QAD TARAQANIAA HAMU KADHAA WA KADHAA.
May Allah accept this supplication.
وَ اَنْتَ بِكَشْفِهٖ عَالِمٌ غَيْرُ مُعَلَّمٍ وَاسِعٌ غَيْرُ مُتَكَلِّفٍ فَاَسْئَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الَّذِىْ وَضَعْتَهٗ عَلَى الْجِبَالِ فَنُسِفَتْ وَ وَضَعْتَهٗ عَلَى السَّمٰوَاتِ فَانْشَقَّتْ وَ عَلَى النُّجُوْمِ فَانْتَثَرَتْ وَ عَلَى الْاَرْضِ فَسُطِحَتْ وَ اَسْئَلُكَ بِالْحَقِّ الَّذِىْ جَعَلْتَهٗ عِنْدَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ اٰلِهٖ وَ عِنْدَ عَلِىٍّ وَّ الْحَسَنِ وَالْحُسَيْنِ وَ عَلِىٍّ وَّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ جَعْفَرٍ وَّ مُوْسٰى وَ عَلِىٍّ وَّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ عَلِىٍّ وَّالْحَسَنِ وَ الْحُجَّةِ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلَامُ اَنْ تُصَلِّىَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اَهْلِ بَيْتِهٖ وَ اَنْ تَقْضِىَ لِىْ حَاجَتِىْ وَ تُيَسِّرَلِىْ عَسِيْرَهَا وَ تَكْفِيَنِىْ مُهِمَّهَا فَاِنْ فَعَلْتَ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَ اِنْ لَمْ تَفْعَلْ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ غَيْرُ جَاۤئِرٍ فِىْ حُكْمِكَ وَلَا مُتَّهَمٍ فِىْ قَضَاۤئِكَ وَلَاحَاۤئِفٍ فِىْ عَدْلِكَ.
WA AANTA BIKASHFIHI A'AALIMUN GHAYRU MUA'ALAMIN WAASIA'UN GHAYRU MUTAKALIFIN FAAAS'ALUKA BIASMIKA ALADHIAA WADAA'TAHU A'ALAAA ALJIBAALI FANUSIFAT WA WADAA'TAHU A'ALAAA ALSAMAAWAATI FAANSHAQAT WA A'ALAAA ALNUJUWMI FAANTATHARAT WA A'ALAAA ALAARDI FASUTIHAT WA AAS'ALUKA BIALHAQI ALADHIAA JAA'ALTAHU A'INDA MUHAMADIN SALAAA U A'ALAYHI WA AAALIHEE WA A'INDA A'ALIAAIN WA ALHASANI WAALHUSAYNI WA A'ALIAAIN WA MUHAMADIN WA JAA'FARIN WA MUWSAAAA WA A'ALIAAIN WA MUHAMADIN WA A'ALIAAIN WAALHASANI WA ALHUJAHI A'ALAYHIMU ALSALAAMU AAN TUSALIAAA A'ALAAAA MUHAMADIN WA AAHLI BAYTIHI WA AAN TAQDIAAA LIAA HAAJATIAA WA TUYASIRALIAA A'ASIYRAHAA WA TAKFIYANIAA MUHIMAHAA FAAIN FAA'ALTA FALAKA ALHAMDU WA AIN LAM TAFA'AL FALAKA ALHAMDU GHAYRU JAA'IRIN FIAA HUKMIKA WALAA MUTAHAMIN FIAA QADAA'IKA WALAAHAA'IFIN FIAA A'ADLIKA.
May Allah accept this supplication.
اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّ يُوْنُسَ بْنَ مَتّٰى عَبْدُكَ دَعَاكَ فِىْ بَطْنِ الْحُوْتِ وَ هُوَ عَبْدُكَ فَاسْتَجَبْتَ لَهٗ وَ اَنَا عَبْدُكَ اَدْعُوْكَ فَاسْتَجِبْ لِىْ.
AALLAAHUMA AINA YUWNUSA BNA MATAAAA A'ABDUKA DAA'AAKA FIAA BATNI ALHUWTI WA HUWA A'ABDUKA FAASTAJABTA LAHU WA AANAA A'ABDUKA AADA'UWKA FAASTAJIB LIAA.
May Allah accept this supplication.
